units.source_text: 他说着，移身向前，坐得靠近些。

en.t: As he spoke, he shifted forward and sat a little closer.

units.source_text: 此时源氏公子也睁开眼睛，不再假寐了。

en.t: At this, Prince Genji also opened his eyes and no longer pretended to sleep.

units.source_text: 头中将大感兴趣，两手撑住面颊，正对着左马头，洗耳恭听。

en.t: The Captain Secretary was greatly interested, propping his cheeks in both hands and facing the Left Master of the Horse as he listened intently.

units.source_text: 这光景正像法师登坛宣讲人世大道，教人看了发笑。

en.t: The scene was just like a monk mounting the pulpit to preach the great truths of human life, and it made one laugh to see it.

units.source_text: 但在此时，各人罄吐肺腑之言，毫不隐讳了。

en.t: Yet by then everyone was pouring out the words deep in his heart, concealing nothing at all.
The Left Master of the Horse then began to speak:
